rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Broke to a two-week high on a short squeeze — ~$281M of shorts liquidated in 24h (nearly 2x the longs) after a weak US jobs report shifted odds toward a Fed hold; Fear & Greed at 24 (extreme fear) marking a likely capitulation low.
positions.driver: BTC is today's clear momentum leader off the ~$58k lows while ETH rolls over (-2 to -5% on the day, losing yesterday's leadership) and SOL stays weak. As the most liquid major it offers the best downside protection with a definable 8% stop — an asymmetric continuation setup on a risk-on macro turn. Entry marked to the dashboard live feed at run time.
positions.risks: Squeeze exhaustion / failure to hold the 2-week-high breakout; a hawkish surprise at the Jul 28-29 Fed; rejection back under ~$60k would flip momentum. Feed asOf timestamp was stale at run time; price cross-checked against the search narrative (BTC ~$61.8k) for consistency.
